vizLead: Use the arrows beside the flow meter to choose its type, then set connector threads and the installation device above. Small gaps between the parts keep every connector easy to identify.
vizNoScript: Enable JavaScript to cycle through flow meter types with the arrows and change connector threads. A compact water meter with external threads is shown by default.
vizTeeAlt: Black plastic T-fitting with two external threaded outlets and one green internal threaded union nut.
vizLayoutHint: Small gaps separate the parts. On narrow screens, scroll the diagram horizontally.
vizLayoutLabel: Installation diagram with an externally threaded flow meter. Water flows from left to right through the tee, elbows and flow meter.
vizAssemblyFemaleAlt: Double-union elbow with green nuts, front view.
vizAssemblyMaleAlt: Elbow with a union on the left and an upward-facing male thread.
vizNippleLeftAlt: Black male-threaded nipple between the left elbow and the flow meter.
vizNippleRightAlt: Black male-threaded nipple between the flow meter and the right elbow.
vizInternalLayoutLabel: Installation diagram with an internally threaded flow meter and male-threaded nipples between the meter and the elbows. Water flows from left to right.
vizAssemblyTopAlt: Upper right elbow with a downward-facing union and a right-facing male thread.
vizPlugAlt: Black male-threaded blanking plug facing down toward the tee.
vizValveExternalAlt: Solenoid valve with a brass body, black coil and external threads at both ends.
vizValveInternalAlt: Solenoid valve with a brass body, black coil and internal threads at both ends.
partMaleElbow: Elbow with union and male thread
vizUdNoteLabel: Important: required U–D straight lengths at the flow meter
vizUdNoteText: Match the straight pipe lengths upstream (U) and downstream (D) of the flow meter to the requirements of your particular model. Check its U–D markings and manufacturer instructions; the spacing in this diagram is illustrative.
vizHubLead: See how the installation components connect.
vizHydraulicChoiceText: Explore the pipes, flow meter and valves.
vizElectricalChoiceText: See how to connect a pump, solenoid valve, or water meter to Autolejek.
vizElectricLead: Choose the pump supply and protection devices, then use Relay 1 on the Autolejek PCB to start the pump. Changing the configuration switches the simulated devices off.
vizElectricBoardHint: The diagram labels each terminal on the green screw connectors.
vizElectricClickHint: The hand icon marks controls you can click or tap. If a breaker trips, select its model to reset it.
vizElectricVinHint: Relay 1 applies the PCB input voltage (VIN) to the contactor coil. The coil’s DC voltage rating must match the selected VIN.
vizElectricHubLead: Choose a device to see its wiring diagram.
vizElectricValveFuseHint: Click or tap the Relay 1 fuse on the board to simulate a blown fuse. Select it again to simulate replacing it.
vizElectricMeterLead: Choose a pulse-output meter to see how it connects to the Autolejek PCB. You can also simulate pulses and a blown 5 V fuse.
vizElectricMeterFuseHint: Click or tap the 5 V fuse to simulate a blown fuse. Select it again to simulate replacing it.
vizElectricMeterWires: Number of wires on the meter
vizElectricMeterReedPickup: Reed-switch pulse pickup on the compact water meter
vizElectricMeterGuide: See the meter wiring instructions in Configure yourself
vizElectricMeterUncountedPulses: Even if the meter still produces pulses, Autolejek cannot count them while the fuse is blown.
vizElectricMeterPoweredPickup: Powered pulse module on the multi-jet water meter
